learningBlocks.primaryDecisionModel: independent hard-constraint classification versus explicit requirement-priority trade-off
learningBlocks.learningObjective: Classify evidence that discriminates independent hard-constraint classification from explicit requirement-priority trade-off.
preconditions: Evidence for availability, and latency is available.
learningBlocks.governingMechanismOrInvariant: The block is governed by one invariant: choose exactly one classification, independent hard-constraint classification or explicit requirement-priority trade-off, from the condition that discriminates the branches. All owned atoms must be satisfied together.

legal: Classify the case as independent hard-constraint classification when availability, latency, residency, and cost requirements can each be treated as non-negotiable constraints.
Classify the case as explicit requirement-priority trade-off when durability, latency, or cost objectives conflict and the stated priority must decide the design.
illegal: Treat independent hard-constraint classification and explicit requirement-priority trade-off as two actions to perform in one diagnosis instead of resolving the discriminating condition.

Choose either branch without testing whether availability, latency, residency, and cost requirements can each be treated as non-negotiable constraints or durability, latency, or cost objectives conflict and the stated priority must decide the design.

failureBoundaries: Reverse the classification from independent hard-constraint classification to explicit requirement-priority trade-off when evidence changes from “availability, latency, residency, and cost requirements can each be treated as non-negotiable constraints” to “durability, latency, or cost objectives conflict and the stated priority must decide the design”, and reverse it in the opposite direction when the evidence changes back.
falseHeuristicsOrMisconceptions: Assume independent hard-constraint classification and explicit requirement-priority trade-off are cumulative steps rather than competing classifications selected by the discriminating evidence.
learningBlocks.transferBoundary: Transfer out of requirements_and_constraints when the evidence supports neither independent hard-constraint classification nor explicit requirement-priority trade-off; otherwise reverse the owned classification when its discriminating condition reverses.
